posts.html:
Forever Unknown.. Hmm how do i start.

Well, Forever Unknown is a group consisted of people who like to help others. We rescue people from hostage situations, but also kidnapp people and hold them for ransome. The group doesnt take no for an answer. We Kill for power and Defends for honor.

If you would like to join the Forever Unknown, please post why you want to join, your ingame name, your gaming experience, and how long have you been playing. We are not afraid to turn you down.

So far in the group:
